notes.title: PRIMITIVE - How it's going #1
notes.content:
Welcome Our Primitive Villagers,
We are super stoked to give you a sneak peek of what we've been cooking up for PRIMITIVE - a survival game set in the ruthless, yet awe-inspiring Stone Age. Buckle up as we journey through time, exploring our game's unique features - you can read it but you can also just watch the below video - it is up to you!

[previewyoutube=PYLWGkVKXUo;full][/previewyoutube]

In-game characters

We are preparing a diverse range of characters and indigenous groups for you to interact with in-game. But don't let their primal allure fool you! Despite the intriguing aesthetic of some of these characters, they epitomize the essence of 'primitive'. They are fierce, uncompromising, and will stop at nothing to ensure their survival, even if it means eliminating you. Remember, in the Stone Age, it's survival of the fittest!

Equipment and Clothing

Our game isn't just about being the strongest or the fastest - it's also about being the smartest. And to survive in this harsh world, you're going to need the right gear. We've designed a ton of primitive tools, weapons, and clothes that are as authentic as they are functional. Get ready to go full caveman mode with your equipment! Here you can see some of them (more in the video).

Crafting, Building, and Climbing

In PRIMITIVE, you're not just surviving, you're thriving. You'll get to craft your tools, build your shelters, and, to put a cherry on top, you'll get to climb. Yeah, you heard that right. Whether you're getting a better view of your surroundings or escaping from a massive mammoth, climbing adds a whole new layer to your gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43286384/cc93e1623f81d98f58eef43dd21aaffe9c74a1ec.png

Deadly Creatures

What's a Stone Age game without the critters, right? In PRIMITIVE, you'll cross paths with a variety of animals, including mammoth-sized... well, mammoths, and big scary cats known as smilodons. Oh, and did I mention massive prehistoric insects? Yeah, we've got those too. Good luck! Hope you will sleep well after seeing that ːlunar2019crylaughingpigː

Character Customization & User Interface

PRIMITIVE is all about making your mark, and that includes customizing your character. You can see that there is plenty of options to be changed! And reel quick access menu to your inventory? Put there only useful things, you don't want to be surprsied having there only primitive knife. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43286384/8780495453bbf128cfc79448518e684bd61338fc.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43286384/5a4270f87991f2bafd74754ee52271f685f11cda.png

Level Design

PRIMITIVE isn't just a survival game; it's a world. Our map spans an impressive 64 square kilometers, packed with lush forests, wide-open steppes, murky wetlands, towering mountains, and even frosty ice landscapes. Each biome is teeming with unique flora and fauna, so you'll never get bored exploring.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43286384/8b7c33165e6b4769212777d2e46d7751b1776f9d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43286384/4278c796a42a2ab30da5cd31e37c06a0c912763e.png

Village Preview & Biomes

Finally, let's talk about our village hubs. These bustling centers of prehistoric life are your go-to spots for trading, crafting, and meeting other characters. Each village is as diverse as the biomes they're nestled in, promising a dynamic and lively gaming experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43286384/68242cd927155d3af6d6eeda5a3bde94c0ac9849.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43286384/89a75fdabb544fea428fd6c4ba7fe3e814a55574.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43286384/b780169934141dc2ec1a2107c38cb8ee6979c028.png


That's it for now! We are thrilled to share more with you as we continue our journey in developing PRIMITIVE. Here's to living dangerously in the Stone Age!
